stage: Phase 2 train-only diagnostic proposal; not a Phase 3 reliability module
question: Does train-prior cross-view depth disagreement associate with grouped held-anchor residuals?

input_contract.policy: Use exactly the referenced fourteen files, explicit train/anchors/priors leaf roots and an independent absolute-path/hash manifest. No asset-directory walking or reference following.

reuse_frozen_cv.fit: Per image/fold, unweighted float64 affine OLS from cached raw_inverse_depth sampled with the frozen OpenCV INTER_LINEAR rule to non-held-out positive inverse_z anchors.
reuse_frozen_cv.normalizer: Median inverse Z of the fit fold only
reuse_frozen_cv.policy: Refit from raw caches with identical D1 formula. No cached full-fit target, valid mask, a/b, normalizer or saved D1 fold parameters define the score. Verify separate full-fit provenance before dependent work.

score.target_query: Each original anchor xy, without its inverse_z or 3D coordinates; point_id used only for global fold assignment
score.source_inverse_z: q_j=a_j[k]*INTER_LINEAR(raw_j,uv_j)+b_j[k]; same held point group excluded from every source fit
score.primary: Arithmetic mean of the two directional disagreements, only when both source queries are available; no alternate aggregation
score.source_views: Both other train views, always. No point-track membership or ground-truth visibility filter.
score.source_sampling_border: 2 <= u < 501 and 2 <= v < 375; 504x378; float64 raw, frozen cv2.INTER_LINEAR/float32 coordinate convention
score.availability: Finite positive target q, source-camera Z and sampled source q, valid fit in both views, finite in-border projection. No clipping, epsilon replacement, fallback, invalid-to-zero or cached prior-valid filtering.
score.query_order: Target-fit status, finite target q, positive target q; then source-fit status, finite transformed coordinates, positive source Z, finite projection, border, finite source q, positive source q, finite disagreement. Record the first failure reason and any available intermediate values.
score.missing_sources: Keep both directional rows and a target row. Exactly one source is one_source_only, none is no_source. Both are excluded from primary association but their counts and available target errors must be reported.
score.possible_occlusion: Record sign(q_j-q_projected); positive means source prior lies nearer. No occlusion threshold, visibility-truth claim, or sign-based exclusion.

analysis.unit: Original anchor observations; 610 target rows and 1220 directional rows retained even when unavailable. Distinct 3D point IDs and shared views are not independent repeats.
analysis.primary_association: Per image and per fold Spearman average ranks between two-source score and D1-formula OOF residual; >=5 finite pairs, otherwise null/reason; constant ranks null.
analysis.descriptive_contrast: Within each image, score-only 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles, NumPy method=linear. Low c<=q1, high c>=q2; if q1>=q2 or either group has <5 observations, unavailable. Report both errors/counts and high-minus-low mean, with all middle rows retained.
analysis.missingness: Per image/fold, total anchors, target-error availability, 0/1/2-source counts and reasons. Report target OOF errors for primary-included and excluded groups and each status; unavailable target error is null. Per six ordered image pairs report availability/reasons, disagreement and sign counts.
analysis.claims: Descriptive sparse proxy only. No p-values, confidence intervals, pooled significance, causal claims, dense accuracy, statistical independence or reliability weights.

gates.engineering: Exact provenance/isolation, unchanged D1 reference formula, 15 fold fits, all 610 target/1220 direction rows, every failure/unknown preserved, synthetic and isolation checks before real execution.
gates.screening_support: Each image: at least 50% of its original anchors have two-source scores and finite target residuals; all five per-fold correlations have >=5 pairs and nonconstant ranks. The 50% rule is an operational stopping rule, not an accuracy threshold.
gates.screening_direction: Each image rho strictly positive; at least 3/5 fold rhos strictly positive in each image; each image high-score minus low-score mean residual strictly positive with defined tertiles. No threshold/magnitude tuning.
gates.if_support_or_direction_fails: Stop this cross-view score route in this scope, retain negative/incomplete evidence; no new score variants, scene search, masks or training.
gates.if_all_screening_gates_pass: Only recommend separately reviewing the same frozen diagnostic extension to fern/flower development scenes. This is not approval for weights, Phase 3, dense confidence or training.
gates.limits: Passing these post-D1 screening rules does not establish significance, useful effect size, truth or robustness. Shared prediction terms, camera/SfM errors, texture-selection bias, occlusion and common-mode wrong depth remain.

required_checks: Analytic pinhole camera translation/rotation, axial Z vs ray length, and exact projection/sampling conventions
Vary held inverse_z in every view: score, source queries, fit parameters and fit normalizers for that fold unchanged; target error changes
No ground-truth 3D point coordinate, source observed track coordinate or held inverse_z enters feature construction
Cached full targets, valid masks, full-fit metadata and saved D1 fold parameters cannot control score/primary selection
Coherent correct plane gives zero disagreement; corrupt one independently sampled source prior changes the score
Coherent wrong-depth local plane may give zero disagreement and nonzero reference error; it must not receive a reliable label
Nonpositive predictions, behind-camera/outside-border queries, failed fits, missing/one-source rows and constant ranks retained with explicit null/status
Score ties/tertiles, inclusion/exclusion counts and 610/1220/15 records; source-prior-closer sign must never filter points
All fourteen input hashes/path guards and no forbidden asset/model imports; validate output location before directory creation and refuse overwrite
Unchanged historical source/inputs/results; CPU/time/RSS/access logs; actual real-run status and all failures preserved

future_execution_contract.partial_failure_policy: Preserve artifacts; no silent retries or parameter changes

outputs: Input/source/config hashes and exact asset access records
Global point-group membership and 15 fit records
All 610 target and 1220 directional rows, including failures/unknowns
Three image and fifteen fold associations plus fixed tertile/missingness summaries
Three train RGB/sparse score/sparse reference-error/missing-status panels; no dense confidence map
Actual CPU resources and concise acceptance/limitations; raw data outside Git
prohibited: Implementation or real score computation in this planning step
Test/evaluation assets, full mixed manifests, checkpoints, original SfM model and source-track expansion
Model/Gaussian loads, inference, rendering, optimizer steps, new triangulation or priors
Distance-based or cross-view reliability weights, photometric-score blends, robust-loss training, extra scenes or threshold search
